description: Synthetic sesslint.profiles.profile parity (stdlib-only vectors; no session payload text).
known_parity_gaps: get_profile and list_profiles need sesslint.profiles.builtin. Rust returns sesslint.profiles.builtin is not available. Python returns a registered profile or a KeyError. Do not copy REGISTRY into the vector expected value.
apply_rule_selection and deselected_rules with only one of select or ignore need ALL_RULES. Rust returns the builtin error. Python filters the rules.
Rust trim does not drop U+001C through U+001F. Python str.strip does.
A float or list schema has no honest Python repr. Rust returns a typed error.
There is no bytes input. Python reports got bytes.
EventValue::Other has no Python type name. Rust returns PYTHON_TYPE_NAME_UNREPRESENTABLE.
A bool is not an f64. true is not coerced to 1.0.
Some finite-float messages use Rust debug text and can differ from Python str at other magnitudes. The locked 0.0, 1.0, 0.2, and 0.3 cases are the ones that match.
